versions.changelog:
ZARZOOM skill 1.0.0 initial release:

- Submit articles, shorts, and videos to ZARZOOM for multi-platform social posting.
- Check submission status, pull analytics, and view which platforms each post will land on.
- Requires user API key (ZARZOOM_API_KEY); guides users where to obtain it if unset.
- Supports image and video uploads via secure presigned URLs with compliance checks.
- Handles platform eligibility per submission and surfaces moderation, rate-limits, and platform targeting to the user.
